C1727.title: FCFraud: Detecting Automated Click Fraud from the User Side
C1727.summary: Md. Shahrear Iqbal et al. proposed FCFraud in 2016, a technique for detecting automated click fraud at the operating system level. It targets botnet-infected user machines where automated clickers simulate fake ad clicks to defraud advertisers, achieving 99.6% ad request classification accuracy and 100% fraudulent process identification rate.

references.title: Fcfraud: Fighting click-fraud from the user side
